audit.whatIsWrong: This side's chart (Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank, Skill, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank) contradicts the already-audited mirror, which set zac__gangplank to Gangplank/Skill/Zac/Zac/Skill/Gangplank/Gangplank. The packet levelChart is a third variant again (Skill, Zac, Skill, Skill, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank).
audit.why: The mirror is already on disk and its finding is explicit: 'Zac owns his 3-5 window, Gangplank outscales, level 6 is genuinely split.' Restating it from this side rather than re-deriving is the rule, and mirror-fix.js would overwrite any disagreement anyway.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to the mirror's chart, ratings rescaled, and the four whys that contradicted it rewritten so the explanation matches the side.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] was the stock 'Cannon Barrage wins fights you are not even in' line and never named Let's Bounce; phases[5] named Trinity Force but not what changes.
audit.why: Level 6 is split because his R knocks up four times on a 120s cooldown while your Cannon Barrage zones the landing — that is the actual content of the stage, per the mirror's own point-3 correction ('Rewrote to describe both ultimates and set the stage to Skill').
audit.corrected: Both ultimates written into phases[4].why; the Sheen-versus-blob-regen flip into phases[5].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer keys everything to 'Track Elastic Slingshot' with no number and never mentions Unstable Matter or Cell Division's revive. dosFull[1] is titled 'Build MR' with a trading line as its detail.
audit.why: Three concrete things decide this lane and none were on the full layer: Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1 (a single attempt you can simply dodge), Unstable Matter deals a percentage of your maximum health every 5s so armour and MR are the wrong instinct, and Cell Division revives him from surviving bloblets so a kill is not a kill until the blobs are cleared.
audit.corrected: All three written into the do's, don'ts, trade rules and phases with real numbers.
sources: enemyKit W cd, range and percentHealth

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is named in report[8] and in the content layer but nowhere in the trade rules or don'ts, and the page simultaneously tells you to 'Build MR'.
audit.why: Unstable Matter's damage is percent-max-health magic damage, so MR helps far less than the page implies, while Grievous Wounds is what actually stops the blob regen from refunding your poke. The two pieces of advice were fighting each other.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal put ahead of resistances in dosFull[2].d and tradeBad.
sources: enemyKit P and W percentHealth/heal flags

edits.before: Barrel-poke — build MR, dodge his E, anti-heal. Gangplank wins the Elastic Slingshot cooldown windows.
edits.after: Barrel-poke, anti-heal, and dodge the fog Slingshot. His W burns percent HP, so armour is not the fix.

edits.before: Q-poke costs him HP and pays you gold. Identify how Zac contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: You out-range him at 1 with Parrrley — bank last-hits and watch the fog line where he charges his E.

edits.before: First barrel chains start zoning his wave positions. Only take the trade when Zac's Elastic Slingshot is down.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1 — one attempt, and if you dodge it level 2 is a wash for both of you.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Zac must walk into your range.
edits.after: His window: Slingshot into the grab, and Unstable Matter chews percent max HP every 5s while blobs heal it.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Elastic Slingshot's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Still his without Grievous Wounds — every blob Cell Division sheds refunds your chip, and his W ignores the armour you bought.

edits.before: Cannon Barrage wins fights you are not even in — watch the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Zac's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Split at 6: Let's Bounce knocks up four times, but Cannon Barrage zones the landing. Use R to deny blobs, not to duel.

edits.before: Trinity Force is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Elastic Slingshot's cooldown.
edits.after: Sheen plus a chained detonation finally out-damages his blob regen — force every fight on it.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Zac carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He is a tank, not a scaler — he can engage you but not kill you, and your kegs delete who he dives for.

edits.before: Chain a barrel behind the wave, Q-pop it as Zac steps to farm, and orange away whatever he answers with.
edits.after: Chain a barrel behind the wave, Q-pop it as Zac steps to farm, and never stand on your own keg for him.

edits.before: Letting him pop your barrels for free — every broken keg is gold and tempo handed across the lane.
edits.after: Chipping him with no Grievous Wounds — he walks over the blobs he sheds and takes it all back.

edits.before: His engage. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 21s at rank 1 — one charge, so dodge it and he has nothing.

edits.before: Zac wastes Elastic Slingshot — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Executioner's before armour — his W burns percent max health.

edits.before: That is Zac's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Every ability he casts sheds a blob; stand on them so he can't reabsorb.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot grounds and knocks up — never fight him in fog.

edits.before: Letting him pop your barrels for free — every broken keg is gold and tempo handed across the lane.
edits.after: Cell Division revives him from surviving bloblets — clear them or he stands back up.

edits.before: Q-poke pays you gold and costs him nothing he can't lick back with blobs -- a true even start where you just bank last-hits and watch his E charge up.
edits.after: Q-poke pays you gold from 625 range and he has no ranged answer at level 1 -- bank the free last-hits and watch the fog line where he charges Elastic Slingshot.

edits.before: A fog-charged Elastic Slingshot knockup into Q grab can chain an all-in before your single early keg can detonate -- this is his one real kill window.
edits.after: A fog-charged Elastic Slingshot knockup into Q grab is his all-in, but at 21s on rank 1 it is a single attempt -- dodge it and level 2 is a wash.

edits.before: Your full kit is online so you can keg-zone again, but he can Slingshot out of a chain and heal the trade with passive blobs -- it nets to skill.
edits.after: His window: he Slingshots out of a keg chain, Unstable Matter chews a percentage of your max HP every 5s, and the blobs he sheds heal it all back.

edits.before: A second keg point lets you Parrrley-poke him as he walks up to farm, but anti-heal decides it -- without it his blob regen erases your chip and the lane stays even.
edits.after: Still his until you buy Grievous Wounds -- Unstable Matter's percent-HP damage ignores the armour you wanted, and Cell Division's blobs refund every scrap of chip you land.

notes: Chart taken from the already-audited mirror (zac__gangplank), not from packet.levelChart — the two disagree (mirror: Gangplank/Skill/Zac/Zac/Skill/Gangplank/Gangplank; packet: Skill/Zac/Skill/Skill/Skill/Gangplank/Gangplank) and the mirror wins per the reuse rule. Worth knowing that the packet chart and the mirror-corrected chart diverge on four of seven rows for this matchup. The mirror's note also reports that the suspectNames scan is tuned too tight; this brief's four flags for Zac are all false positives (plurals and sentence-lead forms), which supports that. focus.text and the loading string still say 'Track Elastic Slingshot' as the spine of the matchup when the real spine is anti-heal — focus.text is 21 chars and under the applier's floor.
